title: Bluegrass Hall of Fame & Museum

services.name: Group Tours & Private Events
services.desc: We love sharing the story of bluegrass, and it’s even better with a crowd. Whether you're organizing a family reunion, school group, or corporate event, we offer special pricing and customizable options for tours, private events, and full building rentals. Bluegrass has come a long way from front porches, hoedowns, and barn dances. But just like always, bluegrass is still best experienced live. The Bluegrass Music Hall of Fame & Museum is located near the bank of the mighty Ohio River in historic downtown Owensboro, Kentucky. services.name: Venue Rental
services.desc: Located in downtown Owensboro with sweeping views of the Ohio River, The Bluegrass Music Hall of Fame & Museum offers a unique venue for events large or small. With multiple event spaces designed with your event in mind and professional staff ready to transform your ideas into reality, The Bluegrass Music Hall of Fame & Museum is the premier venue for a truly memorable event. The Independence Bank Event Room features over 4,000 square feet of private event space, unobstructed river views, and a 990 square foot balcony overlooking the Ohio River and Downtown Owensboro. services.name: Instrument Lessons
services.desc: What’s more authentic than learning AT the Hall of Fame? The Lesson program is designed to make bluegrass music more accessible to all who are interested in learning to play an instrument. For any questions about our education programs, email our Education Director Randy Lanham [email protected]. If you can't join in person lessons, please consider doing our online lessons at www.BluegrassMusicAcademy.org for easy to learn songs on fiddle, guitar, and mandolin, and taught by Randy Lanham. Join us for Music Lessons! All classes are 45 minutes long. Our beginning age for classes is 9 years old for fiddle, guitar, and mandolin, and 12 years old for banjo.
